{{dablink|For other uses of the word "spring," see [[Spring]].}}
'''Alianelle Spring''' is an oasis that lies between [[Cairhien]] and [[Tar Valon]].

When [[Gawyn Trakand]] and some of his [[Younglings]] are near Dumai's Wells, they stop to refill their water reserves as the next opportunity would be Alianelle Spring, four days journey from the Wells.{{ref/book|6|55}}
